summary: Completed backend + frontend integration testing for MobileCart live-control scope on public preview URL. Admin login, product manager upload/media, all requested admin sections, wallet credit/debit ledger, customer wallet card, coupon validation, and insufficient-wallet checkout behavior passed. One critical backend issue remains: auth CORS preflight still returns 400 for preview origin.

critical.issue: Preflight from https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com returns 400 instead of 200/204, despite credentialed auth flow requirements.

action_items: Fix CORS origin/preflight handling for /api/auth/login so OPTIONS returns 200/204 for preview domain with credentials.
After CORS fix, re-run auth regression (login/register/forgot/reset/logout/refresh) in browser context.
Keep backend tests running sequential when password-reset mutation tests are included to avoid credential race in parallel workers.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS middleware in server.py still behaves incorrectly at runtime for preview-origin preflight even with allow_origin_regex configured; deployment/runtime env mismatch or middleware origin matching behavior needs RCA.
Legacy tests in test_dealkr_api.py still use outdated auth payload shapes and can generate noisy false failures; maintainers should align them with current identifier-based login contract.
Auth reset tests that mutate deepak143 credentials can interfere with parallel suites; isolate or serialize those tests.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ lockout user via /api/auth/register during brute-force test. Added one uploaded test media file and temporary wallet ledger notes TEST_UI_CREDIT_* / TEST_UI_DEBIT_* for provided customer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin flows verified with deepak143/deepak143 on /admin. UI upload via product-image-upload-input returned /api/media/<id> and media GET=200. Resource sections (banners/campaigns/coupons/vendors/brands/subscriptions/app-manager/notifications/shipping/gst-tax/settings) rendered. Categories, users/admin-users, orders, payments, auctions, returns-refunds, support-tickets tables rendered. Wallet credit+debit UI applied to p0check_1790113956@example.com and ledger updated while final balance restored to ₹60. Customer account wallet card visible. Checkout coupon WELCOME10 applied and wallet payment showed insufficient-balance rejection without creating order success state.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: send OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin=https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com and Access-Control-Request-Method=POST. Observed 400 response. Expected 200/204 with access-control-allow-origin and access-control-allow-credentials=true. Likely root cause is runtime CORS origin matching/config divergence (environment origin value mismatch, middleware precedence, or ingress-origin transformation) rather than frontend behavior.
